mapper.sql: c.capa_id, c.capa_no, c.source, c.cust_id, u.cust_cd, u.cust_nm, c.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, c.title, c.occurred_on, c.status, c.owner_user_id, o.user_nm as owner_nm, c.contain_due, c.close_due, c.csr_id, (select s.csr_no || ' / ' || s.csr_rev from qms_cust_csr s where s.csr_id = c.csr_id) as csr_label, c.d1_team, c.d2_problem, c.d3_contain, c.d4_cause, c.d5_action, c.d6_verify, c.d7_prevent, c.d8_close, c.ncr_id, n.ncr_no, n.status as ncr_status, c.apr_id, a.status as apr_status, a.requester_id as apr_requester_id, c.contained_at, c.closed_at, c.closed_by, c.cancel_reason, (select count(*) from qms_capa_spread s where s.capa_id = c.capa_id and s.status = 'OPEN') as spread_open_cnt, c.row_ver, c.updated_at

from qms_capa c left join mst_cust u on u.cust_id = c.cust_id left join mst_item i on i.item_id = c.item_id left join sys_user o on o.user_id = c.owner_user_id left join apr_request a on a.apr_id = c.apr_id left join qms_ncr n on n.ncr_id = c.ncr_id

order by
c.capa_no c.occurred_on c.status c.close_due c.updated_at
desc,
c.capa_id desc
mapper.select: select c.* limit #{q.page.size} offset #{q.page.offset}
select count(*)
select c.*

select , case when c.status in ('CLOSED', 'CANCELLED') then null when cast(#{today} as date) > c.close_due then 'CLOSE_OVERDUE' when c.status = 'OPEN' and cast(#{today} as date) > c.contain_due then 'CONTAIN_OVERDUE' else 'ON_TIME' end as due_state
where c.capa_id = #{id}
select status from qms_capa where capa_id = #{id} for update
select status from qms_capa where capa_id = #{id}

select s.spread_id, s.line_no, s.target_type, coalesce(i.item_cd, p.proc_cd, u.cust_cd) as target_cd, coalesce(i.item_nm, p.proc_nm, u.cust_nm) as target_nm, s.status, s.note from qms_capa_spread s left join mst_item i on i.item_id = s.item_id left join mst_proc p on p.proc_id = s.proc_id left join mst_cust u on u.cust_id = s.cust_id where s.capa_id = #{id} order by s.line_no
select ncr_id as id, status from qms_ncr where upper(ncr_no) = upper(#{no}) order by (ncr_no = #{no}) desc, ncr_id limit 1
mapper.update: update qms_capa set ncr_id = #{ncrId} where capa_id = #{id} and status not in ('CLOSING', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED')
mapper.select: select cust_id as id, use_yn from mst_cust where cust_cd = #{cd}
select item_id as id, use_yn, item_class_id as class_id from mst_item where item_cd = #{cd}
select proc_id as id, use_yn from mst_proc where proc_cd = #{cd}
select class_id as id, use_yn from mst_item_class where class_cd = #{cd}

select s.csr_id, (s.overrides ->> 'CONTAIN_DAYS')::int as contain_days, (s.overrides ->> 'CLOSE_DAYS')::int as close_days from qms_cust_csr s where s.cust_id = #{custId} and s.use_yn = 'Y' and s.effective_from <= #{on} and (s.overrides ->> 'CONTAIN_DAYS' is not null or s.overrides ->> 'CLOSE_DAYS' is not null) and (not exists (select 1 from qms_cust_csr_target t where t.csr_id = s.csr_id) or exists (select 1 from qms_cust_csr_target t left join mst_item i on i.item_id = cast(#{itemId} as bigint) where t.csr_id = s.csr_id and (t.item_id = cast(#{itemId} as bigint) or t.item_class_id = i.item_class_id))) order by exists (select 1 from qms_cust_csr_target t where t.csr_id = s.csr_id) desc, s.effective_from desc, s.csr_id desc limit 1

insert into qms_capa (comp_cd, capa_no, source, cust_id, item_id, title, occurred_on, owner_user_id, contain_due, close_due, csr_id, d1_team, d2_problem, d3_contain, d4_cause, d5_action, d6_verify, d7_prevent, d8_close, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{capaNo}, #{f.source}, #{f.custId}, #{f.itemId}, #{f.title}, #{f.occurredOn}, #{f.ownerUserId}, #{containDue}, #{closeDue}, #{csrId}, #{f.d1Team}, #{f.d2Problem}, #{f.d3Contain}, #{f.d4Cause}, #{f.d5Action}, #{f.d6Verify}, #{f.d7Prevent}, #{f.d8Close}, #{by}, #{by}) returning capa_id
mapper.update: update qms_capa set cust_id = #{f.custId}, item_id = #{f.itemId}, title = #{f.title}, owner_user_id = #{f.ownerUserId}, d1_team = #{f.d1Team}, d2_problem = #{f.d2Problem}, d3_contain = #{f.d3Contain}, d4_cause = #{f.d4Cause}, d5_action = #{f.d5Action}, d6_verify = #{f.d6Verify}, d7_prevent = #{f.d7Prevent}, d8_close = #{f.d8Close}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where capa_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{f.rowVer} and status not in ('CLOSING', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED')

(hb_current_comp(), #{id}, #{r.lineNo}, #{r.targetType}, #{r.itemId}, #{r.procId}, #{r.custId}, #{r.status}, #{r.note}, #{by})
mapper.update: update qms_capa set status = 'CLOSING', apr_id = #{aprId}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where capa_id = #{id} and status = 'VERIFIED' and row_ver = #{rowVer}

update qms_capa set status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = now(), closed_by = #{by}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where capa_id = #{id} and status = #{from} and row_ver = #{rowVer}

update qms_capa set status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_reason = #{reason}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where capa_id = #{id} and status not in ('CLOSING', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED') and row_ver = #{rowVer}

update sys_file set locked_yn = 'Y', row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where target_type = 'qms-capa' and target_id = cast(#{id} as varchar) and use_yn = 'Y' and locked_yn = 'N'
